cards.ex: She's been struggling with anxious thoughts ever since she lost her job.
cards.exUz: U ishdan bo'shatilganidan beri xavotirli o'ylar bilan kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda bezovta qiluvchi, salbiy o'ylar.

cards.ex: Try not to work yourself up about the presentation; just be yourself.
cards.exUz: Taqdimot haqida o'zingni qiynama, shunchaki o'zing bo'l.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa haqida haddan tashqari xavotirlanib, stressga tushish.

cards.ex: I always get a jittery feeling before a big exam.
cards.exUz: Katta imtihondan oldin doim hayajon tuyg'usini his qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Asabiylik, bezovtalik yoki qo'rquv hissi.

cards.ex: After a long day of dealing with customers, my nerves are totally frazzled.
cards.exUz: Uzoq kun mijozlar bilan ishlagandan so'ng, asablarim butunlay taranglashadi.
cards.uzDef: Stress va xavotirlikdan charchagan asablar.

cards.ex: When the deadline was moved up, everyone went into panic mode.
cards.exUz: Muddat yaqinlashtirilganda, hamma vahima holatiga tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Vahima va qo'rquv holatiga tushish.

cards.ex: She felt overwhelmed by the sheer amount of work she had to do.
cards.exUz: U qilishi kerak bo'lgan ishning ko'pligidan bosim ostida qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir bilan haddan tashqari bosim ostida qolish.

cards.ex: His anxiety started to spiral out of control when he lost his job.
cards.exUz: Uning ishdan ayrilgandan so'ng xavotiri nazoratdan chiqa boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning tobora yomonlashuvi va nazoratni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: I was on pins and needles waiting for the test results.
cards.exUz: Test natijalarini kutayotib, men igna ustida o'tirgandek edim.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari xavotirda va kutish holatida bo'lish.

cards.ex: I know you're nervous, but try not to bite your nails.
cards.exUz: Asabiylashayotganingni bilaman, lekin tirnoqlaringni tishlamaslikka harakat qil.
cards.uzDef: Xavotirlik yoki asabiylikdan tirnoqlarni tishlash.

cards.ex: She was a bundle of nerves before her wedding.
cards.exUz: U to'yi oldidan asab to'plami edi.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari asabiy va xavotirli odam.

cards.ex: He's been suffering from stress-related headaches lately.
cards.exUz: U so'nggi paytlarda stress bilan bog'liq bosh og'rig'idan aziyat chekmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Stress tufayli kelib chiqqan yoki stress bilan bog'liq.

cards.ex: He knew he had to face the music for his mistakes.
cards.exUz: U xatolari uchun javobgarlikni his qilish kerakligini bilar edi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ish uchun oqibatlarini qabul qilish.

cards.ex: The medication is supposed to help with heightened anxiety.
cards.exUz: Dori kuchaygan xavotir bilan kurashishga yordam berishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Oddatdagidan ko'ra yuqori darajadagi xavotir.

cards.ex: Therapy can help you address your underlying anxiety.
cards.exUz: Terapiya sizning asosiy xavotiringizni hal qilishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Yashirin yoki doimiy xavotirlik holati.

cards.ex: When you feel overwhelmed, just take a few deep breaths.
cards.exUz: O'zingizni bosim ostida his qilsangiz, shunchaki bir necha chuqur nafas oling.
cards.uzDef: Stressni kamaytirish uchun chuqur nafas olish.

cards.ex: The pressure builds up as the project deadline approaches.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muddati yaqinlashganda bosim ortadi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan stress va talablarning ortishi.

cards.ex: The mental load of being a working parent is exhausting.
cards.exUz: Ishlaydigan ota-ona bo'lishning ruhiy yuki charchatadi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda o'ylash va rejalashtirish kerak bo'lgan narsalar yuklama.

cards.ex: Money problems are a major source of stress for many people.
cards.exUz: Pul muammolari ko'p odamlar uchun stressning asosiy manbai hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Stress va xavotirlik keltirib chiqaradigan narsa yoki vaziyat.

cards.ex: Learning to cope with stress is essential for good health.
cards.exUz: Stressga qarshi kurashishni o'rganish sog'liq uchun zarurdir.
cards.uzDef: Stressni boshqarish va kamaytirish usullarini qo'llash.

cards.ex: Crowded places can trigger anxiety for some people.
cards.exUz: Odamlar gavjum joylar ba'zi odamlar uchun xavotirni qo'zg'atishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Xavotirlikni keltirib chiqaradigan narsa yoki vaziyat.

cards.ex: I couldn't sleep because my mind was racing all night.
cards.exUz: Butun tun davomida ongi chopganligi sababli uxlolmadim.
cards.uzDef: Tez va tartibsiz fikrlash.

cards.ex: Meditation is a great stress management technique.
cards.exUz: Meditatsiya stressni boshqarishning ajoyib usuli.
cards.uzDef: Stressni kamaytirish va boshqarish usullari.

cards.ex: She uses music as a form of self-soothing.
cards.exUz: U musiqani o'zini tinchlantirish shakli sifatida ishlatadi.
cards.uzDef: O'zini xavotirlikdan xalos qilish usullari.

cards.ex: His fight-or-flight response kicked in when he saw the bear.
cards.exUz: Ayiqni ko'rganda uning 'urush yoki qochish' reaksiyasi ishga tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfga javob reaksiyasi - urushish yoki qochish.

cards.ex: She was panic-stricken when she realized she'd lost her passport.
cards.exUz: U pasportini yo'qotganini anglab yetgach, vahimaga tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari vahima va qo'rquvga tushgan.

cards.ex: Her presence had a calming influence on the situation.
cards.exUz: Uning ishtiroki vaziyatga tinchlantiruvchi ta'sir ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Xavotirlikni kamaytiradigan ta'sir.

cards.ex: It's easy to wallow in anxiety, but you need to find ways to move forward.
cards.exUz: Xavotirga botish oson, lekin oldinga siljish yo'llarini topish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xavotirda bo'lishdan zavqlanish yoki unga berilib ketish.

cards.ex: I had a nagging worry about whether I'd locked the door.
cards.exUz: Men eshikni qulflagan yoki yo'qligim haqida doimiy bezovta xavotirda edim.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda bezovta qiladigan kichik xavotir.

cards.ex: The pressure to succeed can be overwhelming for students.
cards.exUz: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish bosimi talabalar uchun haddan tashqari bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun his qilinadigan kuchli talab.

cards.ex: He was close to his breakdown point after working non-stop for weeks.
cards.exUz: U haftalar davomida tinimsiz ishlagandan so'ng sinish nuqtasiga yaqin edi.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari stress tufayli sinish nuqtasi.
